# Rev-IQ Advisory

> Rev-IQ Advisory (also known as Rev-IQ, legal name Rev-IQ Advisory Pty Ltd) is a Sydney-based commercial and revenue operations resource for leaders of technology businesses, from SaaS and software to technology services: practical frameworks, templates, and advisory support for founders and executives who want revenue that grows in a straight line rather than a rollercoaster. Founded by Joel Smith. Not affiliated with other businesses trading as Rev-IQ or RevIQ, such as AI sales-call coaching apps or advertising platforms.

Rev-IQ publishes a free resource library of frameworks and templates covering revenue growth, operating rhythm, hiring and org design, security posture, AI strategy, leadership, and partnerships for technology businesses. Content is written in a direct, editorial, expert-led voice, with no fluff, no growth-hacking clichés.

## Flagship frameworks

- [The 5 Levers That Actually Drive SaaS Revenue](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/01-the-5-levers-that-actually-drive-saas-revenue): The core operating logic behind SaaS growth (acquisition, conversion, pricing, retention and expansion) and how to diagnose which lever is the real constraint.
- [Designing a Simple Operating Rhythm for a Growing Business](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/03-designing-a-simple-operating-rhythm-for-your-saas): How to turn a project into a business with a weekly/monthly/quarterly review cadence that fits a small team.
- [The Rev-IQ 3-Pillar AI Strategy Framework](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/30-the-rev-iq-3-pillar-ai-strategy-framework): A sequencing model for AI adoption in technology companies: educate the workforce, operationalise AI internally, then productise it for customers, in that order.

## Resource index

- [Resource Library](https://rev-iq.ai/resources): Full library of 50 frameworks and templates, organised by function, challenge and stage, with six guided paths (revenue engine, retention and expansion, operating discipline, AI adoption, partners, new business).
- [Browse by Challenge](https://rev-iq.ai/browse-by-challenge): Find the right resource by the specific business problem you're facing.
- [Who It's For](https://rev-iq.ai/who-its-for): How Rev-IQ resources map to different leadership roles and company stages.

## Insights

Articles giving Rev-IQ's analysis and point of view on current commercial questions for technology businesses. Each is dated and sources are linked.

- [Insights](https://rev-iq.ai/insights): All Rev-IQ insight articles, newest first.
- [The Five-Year Exit Is Over. Here's How to Get Your Valuation Back.](https://rev-iq.ai/insights/the-five-year-exit-is-over): Investors are holding technology businesses years longer than planned. How big the problem is, how much is AI, and six pathways back to a valuation buyers will pay for.
- [Everyone's using AI. Almost nobody's getting paid for it.](https://rev-iq.ai/insights/everyone-is-using-ai-almost-nobody-is-getting-paid-for-it): Most technology businesses have plenty of AI activity. Very few can show what it's earning. Why AI stalls, and five things the businesses getting results do differently.
- [Targets, pressure and psychosocial safety: can sales culture and the new obligations coexist?](https://rev-iq.ai/insights/targets-pressure-and-psychosocial-safety): Australia's psychosocial safety rules don't ban sales pressure. They expect it to be designed and managed. Eight practical controls that keep sales teams accountable.

## AI Skills

Free AI skills for Claude, ChatGPT and Perplexity, each built on a Rev-IQ framework and run inside the user's own AI account.

- [AI Skills](https://rev-iq.ai/skills): Overview, supported platforms and plans, and install guides.
- [Rev-IQ Commercial Engine Scorecard](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/commercial-engine-scorecard): Scores the five levers that drive revenue and names the one constraint to fix first.
- [Rev-IQ Six SaaS Numbers](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/six-saas-numbers): Calculates MRR, churn, CAC, payback and runway from your P&L and flags what needs attention.
- [Rev-IQ Pipeline Health Check](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/pipeline-health-check): Reads your CRM export, flags stalled deals and missing next steps, and shows the trusted pipeline.
- [Rev-IQ AI Readiness Check](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/ai-readiness-check): Scores tooling, governance, skills and use cases and names the readiness gap to close first.
- [Rev-IQ Positioning Sharpener](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/positioning-sharpener): Works through a seven-part positioning canvas and drafts your statement and headlines.
- [Rev-IQ Founder-led Sales Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/founder-led-sales-kit): Paid bundle (A$149 inc GST) of five skills: GTM motion picker, discovery call prep and debrief, deal qualification scorer, follow-up email writer and account plan builder.
- [Rev-IQ Board and Leadership Pack](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/board-and-leadership-pack): Paid bundle (A$199 inc GST) of four skills: management report drafter, board agenda and pre-read builder, decision rights matrix and executive alignment review.
- [Rev-IQ Retention and Customer Success Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/retention-and-customer-success-kit): Paid bundle (A$149 inc GST) of five skills: onboarding plan builder, customer health scorer, at-risk account save plan, quarterly review call and support tiers and SLA designer.
- [Rev-IQ AI Strategy Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/ai-strategy-kit): Paid bundle (A$199 inc GST) of six skills: 3-pillar AI plan builder, AI use case prioritiser, AI workforce enablement plan, operational AI playbook, AI governance policy drafter and product AI decision.
- [Rev-IQ Partner and Channel Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/partner-and-channel-kit): Paid bundle (A$149 inc GST) of five skills: partner strategy picker, partner fit scorer, partner 90-day activation plan, referral motion designer and partner review cadence.
- [Rev-IQ Security Questionnaire and Trust Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/security-questionnaire-and-trust-kit): Paid bundle (A$199 inc GST) of five skills: security questionnaire responder, security baseline check, access and data policy builder, vendor risk review and incident first-hour plan.
- [Rev-IQ SDR Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/sdr-kit): Paid bundle (A$149 inc GST) of six skills: ICP and target account builder, account research brief, outbound sequence writer, cold call and objection coach, meeting handoff and SDR weekly review.
- [Rev-IQ New Business BDM Kit](https://rev-iq.ai/skills/bundles/new-business-bdm-kit): Paid bundle (A$199 inc GST) of six skills: territory and coverage plan, stakeholder map, business case builder, mutual action plan, proposal and negotiation prep and deal strategy review.
